title: How is Jesus connected to Mia Khalifa?
description:
A Renaissance fresco, 2,000 years of popes and three real photos connect Jesus to sports streamer Mia Khalifa.

Jesus → Saint Peter → Pope Francis → John Kerry → Alexander Ovechkin → Mia Khalifa

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
